name: Star Avenger: Chaos Arena
source:
In the City of New Amsterdam, Star Avenger is caught in the Villain Lady Chaos’s trap. Now she is being forced to fight in the underground Chaos arena where the loser is fucked by the winner.

All the while, they are being slowly brainwashed into becoming sex slaves.

[From [url=https://romenjack.itch.io/star-avenger-chaos-arena]Itch.io[/url]]
